what: salsa: a typed way to read the arguments of a read of a tracked fn of several arguments. blaze_item_hash::reads classifies each read a body step made (salsa::Reads::for_each_read gives DatabaseKeyIndex + debug name). For a fn of one salsa-struct argument the key casts (T::cast(key, page)), but for a fn of several arguments the key is its private interned_arguments struct, which no caller can name: every read of InherentImpls::in_crate_for_self_ty(krate, SelfTyKey), impl_value_item(impl, Name), module_items_named(module, Name), in_crate_trait_value_items(krate, Name), layout_of_ty_query(ty, env), const_eval_query(..), closure_exprs(owner, ()), is_copy_query(env, ty) is refused, so almost no body can be stored. Wanted, in salsa::plumbing: `pub fn interned_arguments<F: Clone + 'static>(db: &dyn Database, key: Id) -> Option<F>`: when the page of `key` holds the interned arguments of a tracked fn whose `Fields<'static>` (its argument tuple with every db lifetime made 'static) has TypeId::of::<F>(), a clone of them; else None. Example: `interned_arguments::<(Crate, SelfTyKey<'static>)>(db, key)`. Idea: an Ingredient method `fn interned_fields(&self, zalsa: &Zalsa, id: Id) -> Option<(TypeId, NonNull<()>)>` that interned::IngredientImpl<C> answers with TypeId::of::<C::Fields<'static>>() and a pointer to the fields (the macro already asserts the fields outlive the db lifetime); no allocation, one page lookup. Tell window item-hash-facts the exact signature when done; until then these reads stay refused (docs/v2/plan/lanes/item-hash/reads.md lists them).

history.note: applied: `salsa::plumbing::interned_arguments::<F: Clone + 'static>(db: &dyn salsa::Database, key: salsa::Id) -> Option<F>` (vendor/salsa/src/interned.rs). Pass a read's `DatabaseKeyIndex::key_index()`; F is the argument tuple with every db lifetime 'static, e.g. `interned_arguments::<(Crate, SelfTyKey<'static>)>(db, key.key_index())`. None when the key's page is not interned or its fields are not F; panics as an interned field getter does if the value was not validated in the current revision. Under it: `Ingredient::interned_fields(&self, &Zalsa, Id) -> Option<&dyn Any>`, answered by interned::IngredientImpl with its stored Fields<'static>. No macro change. Test: tests/capture_reads.rs interned_arguments_reads_a_query_reads_arguments_back
